about_the_game:
Take some load off your fingers with this brand new special edition Boxy & Bloop Auto Clicker.

You will receive 1 Auto Clicker and the special Boxy & Bloop skin.

Get it Now!

You can assign the Auto Clicker to do the following:
- Automatically click on monsters 10 times a second.
- Continuously level up a hero.
- Activate a skill when it's ready.
